content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lancaster

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now. Lancaster's healthcare, manufacturing, and financial-services sectors actively employ PMP-certified professionals—confirm you meet the baseline before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions on a schedule that fits your working life. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full PMI-required curriculum covering project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk—preparing you thoroughly for exam day.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience details. Pay the associated PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify the application process; PMI reviews and approves your eligibility before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll sit for a computer-based, multiple-choice exam that assesses your command of project-management domains and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew. Pursue training, conferences, publications, or volunteer project-management work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PMP-focused learning to help you stay current and meet PMI's renewal requirements.
